result.summary: decision_log.record() now takes an optional role=None kwarg written as a top-level row field only when provided, independent of deterministic/extra. Both new required tests (test_decision_log.py::test_record_accepts_top_level_role, test_skill_scorecard.py::test_selection_rows_read_top_level_role_with_fallback) exist with matching names and correctly exercise precedence and fallback ordering. This resolves the rejected review comment exactly as specified; no regressions found.
